_about: Reference screenshots (1920x1080, lossless WebP = pixel-exact) for testing the bot offline: scripts/ui_probe.py runs the bot's real detection code on a frame, scripts/loot_eval.py scores the loot reader on every frame with a 'loot' entry. Folders are named after the CoC UI they show; capture new ones with scripts/capture_frame.py and describe them here.

old_ui_2026-07/attack_3.webp.screen: Attack scouting screen, pre-update UI, candy scenery

coc_18.647_2026-11/popup_welcome_back.we.screen: 'Welcome Back Chief!' popup on game start. The bot's click_exit (tap 0.99,0.99) dismisses it without opening Build; the 'okay' template only scores 0.63 here

coc_18.647_2026-11/home.webp.screen: Home village. Builder (0/7) and lab (1/2) counters moved from top-center to bottom-right above Build; get_home_builders still looks at the old spot, so the bot never recognises home (slash template still matches 0.95 at the new spot)

coc_18.647_2026-11/build_panel.webp.screen: Build button (or either counter) opens a right-side 'Buildings & Heroes' panel that replaces the old top builder menu. Tabs at the bottom: builders, research, crafting station, pets. Close with its X (0.983,0.031) or a tap outside

coc_18.647_2026-11/upgrade_dialog_builde.screen: Building upgrade dialog with a discount (old price struck through, green tag). The 'confirm' template still matches 0.88 (bot threshold 0.85)

coc_18.647_2026-11/research_panel.webp.screen: Research tab ('Army Upgrades') of the same right-side panel

coc_18.647_2026-11/wall_selected.webp.screen: Wall action bar: Info, Select Row, Upgrade More, Upgrade (gold), Upgrade (elixir), and a blue Upgrade (Wall Ring x4). _wall_upgrade_buttons finds only the gold and elixir buttons (both 'white'); the Wall Ring button is not matched

coc_18.647_2026-11/battle_menu.webp.screen: Battle menu: 'Battle - Find a Match' (1600 gold) and 'Ranked Battle' cards; find_a_match template matches 1.0

coc_18.647_2026-11/army_screen.webp.screen: 'My Army' window opened by Find a Match; the gold is only spent on Attack! (confirm_attack template matches 0.98)

coc_18.647_2026-11/attack_1.webp.screen: Attack scouting screen, post-update UI, candy scenery, enemy without clan

coc_18.647_2026-11/attack_2.webp.screen: Attack scouting screen, post-update UI, jungle scenery

coc_18.647_2026-11/attack_3.webp.screen: Attack scouting screen, post-update UI, forest scenery

coc_18.647_2026-11/attack_4.webp.screen: Attack scouting screen, post-update UI, 7-digit gold and elixir
